text:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #4823 is a small refactor of the catalog tf module. I renamed some outputs, moved the provider block into the module, and adjusted a couple resource names. Planning to merge after one more quick sanity check.

ajay: Quick Q: did you regenerate any lockfiles? I pulled the branch and `terraform init` flagged a provider checksum mismatch.

maria: I updated modules/catalog/versions.tf to bump the google provider constraint to ~> 4.2, but I didn't commit a .terraform.lock.hcl from the module root. I wanted to run the state mv first so I don't commit a lockfile that doesn't match the plan we apply.

devon: Heads-up — you'll need a state move for the renamed resource path. Example:

```
# move state from old module path to new module path
terraform state mv module.catalog.google_service_account.sa module.catalog_v2.google_service_account.sa
```

Also the k8s secret path in our secret-generator changed: secret/data/catalog -> secret/data/catalog-app. That will break the k8s secret manifest unless we update the template.

maria: thanks — here's the sed I used locally to patch the manifest quickly:

```
sed -i '' 's|secret/data/catalog|secret/data/catalog-app|g' infra/k8s/templates/secret-catalog.yaml
```

harper: CI error I saw was specifically: "lock file checksum mismatch" on linux_amd64 runners. We should run a providers lock with the right platforms and commit the lockfile from the same terraform version CI uses. Something like:

```
cd infra/terraform
terraform init
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64
git add .terraform.lock.hcl
git commit -m "regen: lock providers for catalog refactor"
```

ajay: I'll run that locally and push a lockfile. Also checking: did the refactor change provider aliasing? We use provider "google.shared" in a bunch of places — if the hoisted provider was removed it could break calls.

maria: I kept aliasing intact. The module now has a providers map in the module call:

```
module "catalog_v2" {
  source = "./modules/catalog"
  providers = { google = google.shared }
  # other inputs...
}
```

so existing alias should still be wired.

infra-bot: CI: terraform-plan (eng-infra) failed on branch feature/catalog-refactor — plan error: lockfile checksum mismatch. See build #1942.

devon: I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to update the k8s secret template and add a short note in the upgrade.md about the state mv. Avoids last-minute surprises during canary.

harper: LGTM after the lockfile and state migration are committed and a quick apply in staging passes. @ajay can you coordinate the canary apply tomorrow morning? :thumbsup:

ajay: Yep — I'll run canary apply at 09:30 PT and push the lockfile now.

maria: Thanks all. I'll hold the merge until CI is green and the infra-bot approves the plan. Appreciate the quick checks :heart:
